title.justification: The paper title is printed at the beginning of the manuscript.

extractions.description: The paper contributes and empirically evaluates a saliency-robustness verification procedure for Vanilla Gradient, implemented by combining Marabou with Crown/LiRPA and benchmarked against Z3 on BanditNet and mnistfc_256x2.

type.quote: We conduct experiments on our synthetic benchmarks and dataset and a neural network from VNNCOMP23
type.justification: The work proposes a method and reports timed experiments on neural networks and benchmark inputs.

name.quote: we propose a novel method to solve the saliency-robustness problem more effectively, by combining two state-of-the-art techniques in neural network verification
name.justification: The central technical contribution is a new verification method for neural networks.

name.quote: Saliency maps are one of the most popular tools to interpret the operation of a neural network
name.justification: The paper advances the formal evaluation of saliency maps as neural-network explanations.

name.quote: we propose to use formal methods to mathematically prove or disprove a relationship between a saliency map and the prediction of the network
name.justification: Formal methods are used and advanced through a new verification specification and solver construction.

name.quote: ReLU activated neural networks for classification tasks
name.justification: Neural-network classification is the application setting in which the verification method is evaluated.

name.quote: Adversarial attacks against neural networks and the robustness verification problem
name.justification: Adversarial robustness supplies the verification formulation and VNNCOMP evaluation regions, but the main contribution concerns saliency robustness.

name.quote: We train BanditNet, a 2 layers Fully-Connected Network with 6 neurons each
name.justification: BanditNet is a separately trained learned classifier introduced and executed in the paper.

is_contributed.quote: We train BanditNet, a 2 layers Fully-Connected Network with 6 neurons each, on our synthetic benchmark.
is_contributed.justification: The authors train this model for their experiment, making it a paper-specific contributed model.

is_executed.quote: For BanditNet, we verify the saliency-robustness for the whole input domain
is_executed.justification: The paper trains and then runs verification computations involving BanditNet.

is_compared.quote: We run each query using both Z3 and Marabou+Crown/LiRPA
is_compared.justification: The solvers are compared, not BanditNet against another model.

execution_mode.justification: Training has precedence over its later verification-time execution.

referenced_paper_title.justification: BanditNet is introduced in this paper and has no external reference paper.

execution_mode.justification: The paper does not train or finetune it; it executes forward/gradient and verification computations on the pretrained model.
